Features

Key Features

POS Terminal

Full-featured sales register with barcode scanning, multi-payment support, suspend/resume, and thermal receipt printing.

Inventory Management

Track stock across multiple locations, set reorder levels, import/export CSV, and manage item kits and serialized items.

Customer Rewards

Built-in loyalty program with tiered packages, points tracking, and purchase history analytics.

21+ Reports

Sales, inventory, taxes, expenses, employee performance — all with graphical charts, CSV export, and PDF download.

Multi-Tier Tax Engine

Handle complex tax scenarios with destination-based tax, multiple rates per item, and HSN code support.

Expense Tracking

Record and categorize business expenses, track by payment type, and generate expense reports on demand.

FAQ

What types of businesses can use Zaryn?
Zaryn is designed for retail stores, restaurants, and service businesses. It supports multiple sale modes (POS, Return, Invoice, Quote, Work Order), dinner table management for restaurants, and comprehensive inventory tracking.
Can I run Zaryn on my own server?
Yes! Zaryn is fully self-hosted. We provide Docker containers for easy deployment on your own VPS or local server. You have full control over your data.
Does Zaryn support multiple languages?
Absolutely. Zaryn includes translations for 49 languages with per-employee language selection — one of the most comprehensive language supports in the industry.
Is there a free trial?
Contact us for a personalized demo. We offer flexible licensing for businesses of all sizes.
